Shipping & returns

Getting it to you, without the customs surprise.

Saede exists partly because our founder spent years ordering supplements from another continent. Making this easy in Europe is personal.

Draft. DRAFT — NOT LEGAL TEXT. Written as a plain-language starting point so the page exists and reads in Saede's voice. It must be reviewed and completed by a qualified lawyer for the EU market before launch. Company registration country is not yet decided (leaning Spain), and several clauses depend on that.

Where we ship

Across the European Union. Because the products are made in the EU, there are no customs charges or import duties waiting for you on the doorstep.

Cost and timing

PLACEHOLDER — delivery costs and estimated times per country, to be added once the fulfilment partner is confirmed. Delivery cost is always shown at checkout before you pay.

Membership delivery is free.

Your 14-day right of withdrawal

You have 14 days from receiving your order to tell us you are withdrawing from the contract, without giving a reason. Email hello@saede.eu and we will tell you what to do next.

If something arrives damaged or wrong

Email us with a photograph and we will replace it. We are not going to make you argue for that.
